items.headline: Copilot Vision helps users get answers by showing work on screen or through phone camera
items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Vision is rolling out in July 2026, enabling users to show Copilot dashboards, documents, images, error messages, or real-world objects through their screen or phone camera and ask questions in a voice conversation. This multimodal feature accelerates troubleshooting and data analysis by eliminating the need to describe visual context in text.
items.levelshiftAngle: LevelShift's M365 Copilot implementations for clients and our internal team can now leverage Vision for faster troubleshooting of Power BI dashboards, Dynamics 365 screens, and Fabric data models. Add Vision workflow training to our AI Discovery Workshops for Manufacturing and Financial Services clients who rely heavily on visual dashboards.

items.headline: VA awards Salesforce $1.6B contract for Agentforce-powered veteran care and services
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs awarded Salesforce a $1.6 billion, three-year Agentic Enterprise License Agreement on July 24, 2026. The agreement enables VA to provide 24/7 virtual contact center support for patient triage, intake, and care coordination through Agentforce Public Sector and Agentforce Health, marking the largest government Agentforce deployment to date.

items.headline: ChatGPT medical advice lawsuit filed July 2026 after pulmonary embolism linked to chatbot recommendations
items.summary: Scott Winters sued OpenAI in San Francisco County Superior Court in July 2026, alleging ChatGPT-4o dismissed his dizziness and unstable blood pressure symptoms and advised prolonged immobility, leading to a near-fatal pulmonary embolism. The lawsuit claims strict liability, negligence, and unfair competition law violations, highlighting the dangers of unsupervised AI medical advice.
items.levelshiftAngle: This lawsuit validates LevelShift's human-in-the-loop approach and our SOC 2/HIPAA-compliant medical record review service. Our 5-Phase methodology's Controlled Execution (Phase 5) and governance playbooks exist to prevent exactly this failure mode. Use this case in Healthcare client conversations to demonstrate why structured AI implementation with clinical oversight matters, especially for our patient triage and medical records practice.

items.headline: EU AI Act transparency obligations enforceable August 2 2026 with fines up to EUR 15M or 3% revenue
items.summary: The EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations become enforceable August 2, 2026, requiring disclosure when AI systems interact with individuals, generate deepfakes, or produce public-interest content. Violations carry fines up to EUR 15M or 3% of global revenue. National regulators gain active enforcement powers including information requests, model access, and recall authority.
